description_expanded: ABOUT POMPANO PALACE: Vacation begins the moment you lay eyes on this stunning three story home with its luxurious feel but peaceful setting. With over 3,000 s.f. there is room for friends and family to relax on the balcony, gather around the large island in the kitchen, or retreat to one of four bedrooms which include private bathrooms. Bedrooms boast King sized beds, and a new addition of one twin daybed with one twin trundle bed for a max occupancy of twelve guests. This home is the perfect sanctuary for a beach holiday! Pompano Palace sits on a quiet cul-de-sac shared with only a few other homes. On the first floor there is a large entry, elevator, washer and dryer, elevator access to 2nd and 3rd floors and the first bedroom with private en-suite. The second floor includes a beautiful, modern kitchen with high end stainless steel appliances surrounded by a magnificent center island. The kitchen overlooks the living room and dining room which is perfect for the family to come together. On the third floor there is a master retreat which includes a King sized bed, wet bar, and is steps away from the balcony where you can sit and watch the sunset over the emerald shores. Additionally, the third floor is a great place for the family to gather, play a game, or read a book during the day. ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood located along Florida's scenic Highway 30A. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal getaway for visitors seeking a more laid-back vacation experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. When you stay in Inlet Beach you are never far from the beach, or a magnificent view. To explore 30A, take a bike ride to Rosemary Beach to enjoy the farmers market, discover the new 30A Avenue shops, taste the fine local cuisine, and visit local businesses along 30A. Visitors can also explore the neighboring beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Aly's Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options. For additional shopping and adventure, take a family drive to Pier Park in Panama City Beach or travel to the Sandestin Outlet shops. Inlet Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. With its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of recreational opportunities, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Inlet Beach Regional Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * 4 Bikes included * Steps to the beach * Community Pool PARKING: * Free Parking up to 2-3 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older *Additional $500.00 refundable security deposit charged at confirmation ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties, and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. **Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on at all times. At any given point, adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction without notification. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
